findings.sourceEnglish: Observe and Manage Pests and Disease
findings.candidate: Sedzani ni lange Pests na Disease.
findings.finding: Observe/manage framing is translated; pests and disease remain exact technical terms.

findings.sourceEnglish: Identify the cause before treating damage
findings.candidate: Wanani tshiitisi tsha damage ni sa athu treating.
findings.finding: Find the cause before treatment is preserved.

findings.sourceEnglish: Check water, roots, nutrition and beneficial insects
findings.candidate: Ṱolani maḓi, roots, nutrition na beneficial insects.
findings.finding: Water, roots, nutrition and beneficial insects remain the full checklist.

findings.sourceEnglish: Use suitable physical or crop-care measures and monitor results
findings.candidate: Shumisani physical kana crop-care measures zwo teaho ni monitor results.
findings.finding: Suitable physical or crop-care measures and monitoring remain explicit; no treatment is prescribed.

findings.sourceEnglish: If treatment is needed, use a registered product for the crop and pest and follow the label
findings.candidate: Arali treatment i tshi ṱoḓea, use a registered product for the crop and pest and follow the label.
findings.finding: If-needed condition is localized; registered product for crop and pest and label instruction remain exact English.

findings.sourceEnglish: If a pest problem needs a treatment product, what should guide its use?
findings.candidate: Arali pest problem i tshi ṱoḓa treatment product, ndi mini tshine tsha fanela u langa u shumiswa hayo?
findings.finding: Conditional pest-problem/needed-product context and the question about what guides use are preserved.

findings.sourceEnglish: A product registered for the crop and pest, used according to its label
findings.candidate: A product registered for the crop and pest, used according to its label
Product iṅwe na iṅwe ine ya ṱaluswa sa natural.
findings.finding: “Any product described as natural” distractor retains any-product scope and descriptor.

findings.sourceEnglish: A neighbour’s dose for a different crop
findings.candidate: A neighbour’s dose for a different crop
findings.finding: Neighbour dose and different crop remain exact.

findings.sourceEnglish: Crop, pest, dose, protection and harvest waiting instructions matter. A natural origin does not make an improvised treatment safe or suitable.
findings.candidate: Crop, pest, dose, protection and harvest waiting instructions matter. A natural origin does not make an improvised treatment safe or suitable.
findings.finding: Retains crop/pest/dose/protection/harvest waiting safeguards and rejects natural origin as proof of safety/suitability.

findings.sourceEnglish: A farmer's brassica leaves are turning yellow. Before assuming pests, what should she check first?
findings.candidate: Musi maṱari a brassica a murimi a tshi khou vha yellow, u sa athu humbulela uri ndi pests, u fanela u thoma u ṱola mini?
findings.finding: The yellowing scenario, before-assuming-pests condition, and what-to-check-first question remain. Tshivenda uses a generic singular address without a gender distinction; question mode is preserved.

findings.sourceEnglish: Whether it's actually a soil nutrient or watering issue
findings.candidate: Arali hu vhukuma thaidzo ya soil nutrient kana watering.
findings.finding: “Actually” is retained and soil-nutrient vs watering alternatives remain.

findings.sourceEnglish: Whether the moon phase is right for treatment
findings.candidate: Whether the moon phase is right for treatment

findings.sourceEnglish: Whether her neighbour has the same problem
findings.candidate: Arali muhura wawe a tshi na thaidzo i fanaho.

findings.sourceEnglish: Yellowing has several common causes, and a soil or watering issue needs a completely different fix than a pest does — checking first avoids wasted treatment.
findings.candidate: Yellowing has several common causes, and a soil or watering issue needs a completely different fix than a pest does — checking first avoids wasted treatment.
findings.finding: Preserves several-cause warning, different fix for soil/watering vs pest, and checking before wasted treatment.
